write_up: This is a strong security resume! Your work at Capital Ridge Bank shows both the detection rules you built and the faster incident containment you led. A recruiter can see how your earlier SOC work at Northgate led to your current detection and response role.

The Splunk detection line is the model: it names the rules, the framework and the reduction in false positives. Your current role leads, your certifications are easy to find, and the headline matches the work.

The purple-team and automation lines could say a little more about what they tested and added. Your resume isn't likely to be the thing holding you back; competition for a role and a referral can matter too.
